description.zh: 视频游戏（玩法优先）蓝图编辑器与运行时 · 演出节点图 + Boss 战 / 血条 / QTE 闯关 / 限时·暂停选择 / 可点热点，新引擎 GameGraph 为唯一 SSOT
description.en: Video-game (gameplay-on-video) blueprint editor & runtime — a graph of performance nodes with boss battles, HP bars, QTE, timed/pause choices, clickable hotspots. The GameGraph engine is the single source of truth.

description.zh: 读取当前 game 的 GameGraph 蓝图（演出节点图 scenarios.graph.json）；无盘数据时回退内置 demo。改图前先调它拿现有 nodes/edges。
description.en: Read the current game's GameGraph blueprint (scenarios.graph.json, a graph of performance nodes); falls back to the built-in demo when no disk data. Call before editing to get existing nodes/edges.

description.zh: 整本覆盖写当前 game 的 GameGraph 蓝图并压一版快照（留10）。落盘前做结构校验（节点 id 唯一、边 source/target 指向存在节点），有 error 则拒绝。典型：get-graph → 改 nodes/edges（加节点、把 A→B 的连线改成 A→C、折条件到出边）→ save-graph。
description.en: Whole-document overwrite of the current game's GameGraph blueprint plus a version snapshot (keeps 10). Structurally validated before write (unique node ids, edges reference existing nodes); rejected on errors. Typical: get-graph → edit nodes/edges (add nodes, relink A→B to A→C, fold conditions onto edges) → save-graph.

description.zh: 列出内置演出视频库可用的 media.ref（basename）。编排节点绑视频前先调它看有哪些片段。
description.en: List available built-in performance-video media.ref values (basenames). Call before binding videos to nodes.
